--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/server/auth/method/kubernetes/server.go
@@ -0,0 +1,315 @@
+// Package kubernetes implements the Kubernetes authentication method for Flipt.
+//
+// The method authenticates requests using Kubernetes service account tokens.
+// A service account token is a JSON Web Token (JWT) issued by the Kubernetes
+// API server, which acts as an OIDC provider. The token presented on a request
+// (via the "Authorization: Bearer <token>" header) is validated against the
+// cluster's OIDC provider: its signature is verified against the API server's
+// JSON Web Key Set, and its issuer, audience and expiry are checked.
+//
+// When running inside a Kubernetes cluster without explicit configuration,
+// standard in-cluster defaults are used for the API server endpoint, the
+// certificate authority and the service account token location.
+package kubernetes
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"fmt"
+	"net/http"
+	"os"
+	"strings"
+	"sync"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/coreos/go-oidc/v3/oidc"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/errors"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	storageauth "go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/storage/auth"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+	"go.uber.org/zap"
+	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/timestamppb"
+)
+
+const (
+	// storage metadata keys under which service account identity details are
+	// recorded on the created Authentication.
+	storageMetadataSubjectKey     = "io.flipt.auth.kubernetes.subject"
+	storageMetadataNamespaceKey   = "io.flipt.auth.kubernetes.service_account.namespace"
+	storageMetadataServiceNameKey = "io.flipt.auth.kubernetes.service_account.name"
+	storageMetadataServiceUIDKey  = "io.flipt.auth.kubernetes.service_account.uid"
+
+	// subjectServiceAccountPrefix is the prefix of the "sub" claim of all
+	// Kubernetes service account tokens.
+	subjectServiceAccountPrefix = "system:serviceaccount:"
+
+	// defaultHTTPTimeout bounds discovery and JWKS round trips to the API server.
+	defaultHTTPTimeout = 10 * time.Second
+)
+
+// serviceAccountClaims captures the Kubernetes specific claims present on a
+// service account token. These are in addition to the standard OIDC claims
+// (iss, sub, aud, exp) exposed directly on the verified IDToken.
+type serviceAccountClaims struct {
+	Namespace          string `json:"kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace"`
+	ServiceAccountName string `json:"kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/service-account.name"`
+	ServiceAccountUID  string `json:"kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/service-account.uid"`
+}
+
+// Server validates Kubernetes service account tokens against the cluster's
+// OIDC provider and issues Flipt Authentication records for them.
+//
+// A Server is not able to authenticate requests until Init has completed
+// successfully. Init performs configuration resolution (applying in-cluster
+// defaults), verifies the credential files are accessible and performs OIDC
+// discovery against the API server, building the verifier used to validate
+// tokens. This surfaces misconfiguration (unreachable endpoint, missing
+// certificate file, invalid issuer) as a clear startup error.
+type Server struct {
+	logger *zap.Logger
+	store  storageauth.Store
+	config config.AuthenticationConfig
+
+	// issuer is the resolved API server issuer URL.
+	issuer string
+	// verifier validates service account tokens against the cluster's key set.
+	verifier *oidc.IDTokenVerifier
+
+	// cache maps a service account subject to the most recent Authentication
+	// issued for it, so repeated requests from the same service account do not
+	// create a new Authentication record each time.
+	mu    sync.RWMutex
+	cache map[string]*auth.Authentication
+}
+
+// NewServer constructs and configures a new *Server. The supplied
+// configuration's Kubernetes method (config.Methods.Kubernetes) is used by
+// Init to resolve the effective settings.
+func NewServer(logger *zap.Logger, store storageauth.Store, config config.AuthenticationConfig) *Server {
+	return &Server{
+		logger: logger,
+		store:  store,
+		config: config,
+		cache:  make(map[string]*auth.Authentication),
+	}
+}
+
+// Init prepares the Server for authenticating requests. It resolves the
+// Kubernetes configuration (applying in-cluster deployment defaults where
+// values are omitted), ensures the service account token and certificate
+// authority files are accessible, and performs OIDC discovery against the
+// cluster API server to build the token verifier.
+//
+// It returns a descriptive error when the configuration cannot be resolved,
+// a required file is missing, or the cluster endpoint cannot be reached.
+func (s *Server) Init(ctx context.Context) error {
+	resolved, err := s.config.Methods.Kubernetes.Method.Resolve()
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("resolving kubernetes authentication configuration: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	if err := s.validateCredentialFiles(resolved); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+
+	client, err := newHTTPClient(resolved.CAPath)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+
+	provider, err := oidc.NewProvider(oidc.ClientContext(ctx, client), resolved.IssuerURL)
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("discovering OIDC provider at %q: %w", resolved.IssuerURL, err)
+	}
+
+	s.issuer = resolved.IssuerURL
+	s.verifier = provider.Verifier(&oidc.Config{
+		// No client ID is configured for this method; the token audience is the
+		// cluster API server, not Flipt, so the client ID check is skipped. The
+		// issuer, signature and expiry are still verified.
+		SkipClientIDCheck: true,
+	})
+
+	s.logger.Debug("kubernetes authentication verifier initialised",
+		zap.String("issuer", s.issuer))
+
+	return nil
+}
+
+// validateCredentialFiles ensures the configured service account token and
+// certificate authority files exist and are readable.
+func (s *Server) validateCredentialFiles(resolved config.ResolvedKubernetesConfig) error {
+	if err := accessible(resolved.ServiceAccountTokenPath); err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("kubernetes service account token file: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	if err := accessible(resolved.CAPath); err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("kubernetes certificate authority file: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	return nil
+}
+
+// accessible reports whether the file at path exists and is readable.
+func accessible(path string) error {
+	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("file %q is not accessible: %w", path, err)
+	}
+
+	if len(data) == 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("file %q is empty", path)
+	}
+
+	return nil
+}
+
+// newHTTPClient builds an http.Client that validates the API server's TLS
+// certificate against the certificate authority at caPath.
+func newHTTPClient(caPath string) (*http.Client, error) {
+	caData, err := os.ReadFile(caPath)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading certificate authority file %q: %w", caPath, err)
+	}
+
+	pool := x509.NewCertPool()
+	if !pool.AppendCertsFromPEM(caData) {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no valid certificates found in certificate authority file %q", caPath)
+	}
+
+	return &http.Client{
+		Timeout: defaultHTTPTimeout,
+		Transport: &http.Transport{
+			TLSClientConfig: &tls.Config{
+				RootCAs:    pool,
+				MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12,
+			},
+		},
+	}, nil
+}
+
+// Authenticate validates the supplied Kubernetes service account token against
+// the cluster's OIDC provider and returns the associated Flipt Authentication.
+//
+// On success a valid token results in an Authentication of method
+// auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES being created (or re-used) in the backing
+// authentication store, with the service account identity recorded as metadata
+// and the expiry derived from the token's expiry claim.
+func (s *Server) Authenticate(ctx context.Context, token string) (*auth.Authentication, error) {
+	idToken, err := s.Validate(ctx, token)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	sub := idToken.Subject
+
+	s.mu.RLock()
+	if cached, ok := s.cache[sub]; ok && !isExpired(cached) {
+		s.mu.RUnlock()
+		return cached, nil
+	}
+	s.mu.RUnlock()
+
+	metadata := serviceAccountMetadata(idToken)
+
+	_, a, err := s.store.CreateAuthentication(ctx, &storageauth.CreateAuthenticationRequest{
+		Method:    auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES,
+		ExpiresAt: timestamppb.New(idToken.Expiry),
+		Metadata:  metadata,
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("creating kubernetes authentication: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	s.mu.Lock()
+	s.cache[sub] = a
+	s.mu.Unlock()
+
+	return a, nil
+}
+
+// Validate verifies the supplied raw service account token against the
+// cluster's OIDC provider. It returns the verified IDToken on success.
+//
+// The token is rejected when its signature cannot be verified against the
+// cluster key set, its issuer does not match the configured API server, it is
+// expired, or its subject is not a Kubernetes service account.
+func (s *Server) Validate(ctx context.Context, token string) (*oidc.IDToken, error) {
+	if s.verifier == nil {
+		return nil, errors.ErrUnauthenticatedf("kubernetes authentication is not initialised")
+	}
+
+	if token == "" {
+		return nil, errors.ErrUnauthenticatedf("empty service account token")
+	}
+
+	idToken, err := s.verifier.Verify(ctx, token)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, errors.ErrUnauthenticatedf("verifying service account token: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	if !strings.HasPrefix(idToken.Subject, subjectServiceAccountPrefix) {
+		return nil, errors.ErrUnauthenticatedf("token subject %q is not a kubernetes service account", idToken.Subject)
+	}
+
+	return idToken, nil
+}
+
+// serviceAccountMetadata derives the service account namespace, name and uid
+// from the verified token, preferring the dedicated kubernetes.io claims and
+// falling back to parsing the subject. It builds the metadata map recorded on
+// the created Authentication.
+func serviceAccountMetadata(idToken *oidc.IDToken) map[string]string {
+	var c serviceAccountClaims
+	// ignore unmarshal errors: not all tokens carry the dedicated claims
+	_ = idToken.Claims(&c)
+
+	metadata := map[string]string{
+		storageMetadataSubjectKey: idToken.Subject,
+	}
+
+	set := func(key, val string) {
+		if val != "" {
+			metadata[key] = val
+		}
+	}
+
+	set(storageMetadataNamespaceKey, c.Namespace)
+	set(storageMetadataServiceNameKey, c.ServiceAccountName)
+	set(storageMetadataServiceUIDKey, c.ServiceAccountUID)
+
+	// fall back to parsing the subject when the dedicated claims are absent
+	// subject format: system:serviceaccount:<namespace>:<name>
+	if ns, name, ok := parseSubject(idToken.Subject); ok {
+		if c.Namespace == "" {
+			set(storageMetadataNamespaceKey, ns)
+		}
+		if c.ServiceAccountName == "" {
+			set(storageMetadataServiceNameKey, name)
+		}
+	}
+
+	return metadata
+}
+
+// parseSubject extracts the namespace and service account name from a
+// service account subject of the form "system:serviceaccount:<ns>:<name>".
+func parseSubject(sub string) (namespace, name string, ok bool) {
+	rest, found := strings.CutPrefix(sub, subjectServiceAccountPrefix)
+	if !found {
+		return "", "", false
+	}
+
+	namespace, name, found = strings.Cut(rest, ":")
+	if !found || namespace == "" || name == "" {
+		return "", "", false
+	}
+
+	return namespace, name, true
+}
+
+// isExpired reports whether the Authentication's expiry is in the past.
+func isExpired(a *auth.Authentication) bool {
+	return a != nil && a.ExpiresAt != nil && a.ExpiresAt.AsTime().Before(time.Now())
+}

+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/server/auth/method/kubernetes"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/storage/auth/memory"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+	"go.uber.org/zap/zaptest"
+)
+
+// b64url base64url-encodes without padding.
+func b64url(b []byte) string {
+	return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(b)
+}
+
+// signJWT signs the provided claims as an RS256 JWT using priv.
+func signJWT(t *testing.T, priv *rsa.PrivateKey, claims map[string]any) string {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	header := map[string]string{"alg": "RS256", "typ": "JWT"}
+	hb, err := json.Marshal(header)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	cb, err := json.Marshal(claims)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	signingInput := b64url(hb) + "." + b64url(cb)
+	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(signingInput))
+	sig, err := rsa.SignPKCS1v15(rand.Reader, priv, crypto.SHA256, sum[:])
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	return signingInput + "." + b64url(sig)
+}
+
+// selfSignedCAPEM generates a self-signed certificate and returns it as PEM.
+func selfSignedCAPEM(t *testing.T) []byte {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	priv, err := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	tmpl := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(1),
+		Subject:               pkix.Name{CommonName: "test-ca"},
+		NotBefore:             time.Now().Add(-time.Hour),
+		NotAfter:              time.Now().Add(24 * time.Hour),
+		IsCA:                  true,
+		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageCertSign,
+		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
+	}
+
+	der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, tmpl, tmpl, &priv.PublicKey, priv)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	return pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: der})
+}
+
+// testCAFile writes a self-signed CA cert to a temp file and returns its path.
+func testCAFile(t *testing.T) string {
+	t.Helper()
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ca.crt")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, selfSignedCAPEM(t), 0o600))
+	return path
+}
+
+// testTokenFile writes a dummy service account token to a temp file and returns
+// its path. The contents are irrelevant to validation (the token presented on
+// the request is what is validated); the file just needs to exist and be
+// non-empty.
+func testTokenFile(t *testing.T, content string) string {
+	t.Helper()
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "token")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(content), 0o600))
+	return path
+}
+
+// startTestProvider spins up an in-memory OIDC provider signed with a fresh RSA
+// key, returning the provider and the private key used to sign tokens.
+func startTestProvider(t *testing.T) (*capoidc.TestProvider, *rsa.PrivateKey) {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	priv, err := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	tp := capoidc.StartTestProvider(t,
+		capoidc.WithNoTLS(),
+		capoidc.WithTestDefaults(&capoidc.TestProviderDefaults{
+			ClientID: ptrStr("client"),
+			SigningKey: &capoidc.TestSigningKey{
+				PrivKey: priv,
+				PubKey:  priv.Public(),
+				Alg:     capoidc.RS256,
+			},
+		}),
+	)
+	t.Cleanup(tp.Stop)
+
+	return tp, priv
+}
+
+func ptrStr(v string) *string { return &v }
+
+// saClaims builds the claims for a Kubernetes service account token.
+func saClaims(issuer, sub string, extra map[string]any, exp time.Time) map[string]any {
+	now := time.Now()
+	claims := map[string]any{
+		"iss": issuer,
+		"sub": sub,
+		"aud": []string{issuer},
+		"exp": exp.Unix(),
+		"iat": now.Unix(),
+		"nbf": now.Add(-time.Minute).Unix(),
+		"jti": "test-jti",
+	}
+	for k, v := range extra {
+		claims[k] = v
+	}
+	return claims
+}
+
+func kubernetesConfig(issuer, caPath, tokenPath string) config.AuthenticationConfig {
+	return config.AuthenticationConfig{
+		Methods: config.AuthenticationMethods{
+			Kubernetes: config.AuthenticationMethod[config.AuthenticationMethodKubernetesConfig]{
+				Enabled: true,
+				Method: config.AuthenticationMethodKubernetesConfig{
+					IssuerURL:               issuer,
+					CAPath:                  caPath,
+					ServiceAccountTokenPath: tokenPath,
+				},
+			},
+		},
+	}
+}
+
+func Test_Server_Authenticate(t *testing.T) {
+	var (
+		ctx    = context.Background()
+		logger = zaptest.NewLogger(t)
+		store  = memory.NewStore()
+	)
+
+	tp, priv := startTestProvider(t)
+	caPath := testCAFile(t)
+	tokenPath := testTokenFile(t, "dummy-in-cluster-token")
+
+	server := kubernetes.NewServer(logger, store, kubernetesConfig(tp.Addr(), caPath, tokenPath))
+	require.NoError(t, server.Init(ctx))
+
+	t.Run("valid token produces authentication", func(t *testing.T) {
+		sub := "system:serviceaccount:default:my-service"
+		exp := time.Now().UTC().Add(time.Hour)
+		token := signJWT(t, priv, saClaims(tp.Addr(), sub, map[string]any{
+			"kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace":            "default",
+			"kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/service-account.name": "my-service",
+			"kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/service-account.uid":  "uid-1234",
+		}, exp))
+
+		a, err := server.Authenticate(ctx, token)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		require.NotNil(t, a)
+		assert.Equal(t, auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES, a.Method)
+		require.NotNil(t, a.ExpiresAt)
+		assert.WithinDuration(t, exp, a.ExpiresAt.AsTime(), time.Second)
+
+		// identity metadata recorded
+		assert.Equal(t, sub, a.Metadata["io.flipt.auth.kubernetes.subject"])
+		assert.Equal(t, "default", a.Metadata["io.flipt.auth.kubernetes.service_account.namespace"])
+		assert.Equal(t, "my-service", a.Metadata["io.flipt.auth.kubernetes.service_account.name"])
+		assert.Equal(t, "uid-1234", a.Metadata["io.flipt.auth.kubernetes.service_account.uid"])
+	})
+
+	t.Run("repeated token reuses authentication (cache)", func(t *testing.T) {
+		sub := "system:serviceaccount:default:cached-sa"
+		exp := time.Now().UTC().Add(time.Hour)
+		claims := saClaims(tp.Addr(), sub, map[string]any{
+			"kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace":            "default",
+			"kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/service-account.name": "cached-sa",
+		}, exp)
+
+		a1, err := server.Authenticate(ctx, signJWT(t, priv, claims))
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+
+		a2, err := server.Authenticate(ctx, signJWT(t, priv, claims))
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+
+		assert.Equal(t, a1.Id, a2.Id, "expected the same Authentication to be re-used")
+	})
+
+	t.Run("expired token is rejected", func(t *testing.T) {
+		sub := "system:serviceaccount:default:expired-sa"
+		token := signJWT(t, priv, saClaims(tp.Addr(), sub, nil, time.Now().UTC().Add(-time.Hour)))
+		_, err := server.Authenticate(ctx, token)
+		require.Error(t, err)
+	})
+
+	t.Run("token signed by wrong key is rejected", func(t *testing.T) {
+		otherPriv, err := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		sub := "system:serviceaccount:default:rogue-sa"
+		token := signJWT(t, otherPriv, saClaims(tp.Addr(), sub, nil, time.Now().UTC().Add(time.Hour)))
+		_, err = server.Authenticate(ctx, token)
+		require.Error(t, err)
+	})
+
+	t.Run("token with wrong issuer is rejected", func(t *testing.T) {
+		sub := "system:serviceaccount:default:wrong-issuer"
+		token := signJWT(t, priv, saClaims("https://evil.example.com", sub, nil, time.Now().UTC().Add(time.Hour)))
+		_, err := server.Authenticate(ctx, token)
+		require.Error(t, err)
+	})
+
+	t.Run("non-service-account subject is rejected", func(t *testing.T) {
+		token := signJWT(t, priv, saClaims(tp.Addr(), "some:other:subject", nil, time.Now().UTC().Add(time.Hour)))
+		_, err := server.Authenticate(ctx, token)
+		require.Error(t, err)
+	})
+
+	t.Run("garbage token is rejected", func(t *testing.T) {
+		_, err := server.Authenticate(ctx, "not-a-jwt")
+		require.Error(t, err)
+	})
+
+	t.Run("empty token is rejected", func(t *testing.T) {
+		_, err := server.Authenticate(ctx, "")
+		require.Error(t, err)
+	})
+}
+
+func Test_Server_Init_Errors(t *testing.T) {
+	var (
+		ctx    = context.Background()
+		logger = zaptest.NewLogger(t)
+		store  = memory.NewStore()
+	)
+
+	t.Run("missing CA file", func(t *testing.T) {
+		tp, _ := startTestProvider(t)
+		tokenPath := testTokenFile(t, "token")
+		conf := kubernetesConfig(tp.Addr(), filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "does-not-exist.crt"), tokenPath)
+		server := kubernetes.NewServer(logger, store, conf)
+		err := server.Init(ctx)
+		require.Error(t, err)
+		assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "certificate authority")
+	})
+
+	t.Run("CA file with no valid certificates", func(t *testing.T) {
+		tp, _ := startTestProvider(t)
+		tokenPath := testTokenFile(t, "token")
+		badCA := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "bad-ca.crt")
+		require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(badCA, []byte("not a pem cert"), 0o600))
+		conf := kubernetesConfig(tp.Addr(), badCA, tokenPath)
+		server := kubernetes.NewServer(logger, store, conf)
+		err := server.Init(ctx)
+		require.Error(t, err)
+		assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "no valid certificates")
+	})
+
+	t.Run("missing service account token file", func(t *testing.T) {
+		tp, _ := startTestProvider(t)
+		caPath := testCAFile(t)
+		conf := kubernetesConfig(tp.Addr(), caPath, filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "does-not-exist"))
+		server := kubernetes.NewServer(logger, store, conf)
+		err := server.Init(ctx)
+		require.Error(t, err)
+		assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "service account token file")
+	})
+
+	t.Run("unreachable cluster endpoint", func(t *testing.T) {
+		caPath := testCAFile(t)
+		tokenPath := testTokenFile(t, "token")
+		// point at a closed local port so discovery fails
+		conf := kubernetesConfig("https://127.0.0.1:1", caPath, tokenPath)
+		server := kubernetes.NewServer(logger, store, conf)
+		err := server.Init(ctx)
+		require.Error(t, err)
+		assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "discovering OIDC provider")
+	})
+
+	t.Run("invalid issuer url", func(t *testing.T) {
+		caPath := testCAFile(t)
+		tokenPath := testTokenFile(t, "token")
+		conf := kubernetesConfig("not a url", caPath, tokenPath)
+		server := kubernetes.NewServer(logger, store, conf)
+		err := server.Init(ctx)
+		require.Error(t, err)
+	})
+}
+
+func Test_Resolve_InClusterDefaults(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv(config.KubernetesServiceHostEnvVar, "")
+	t.Setenv(config.KubernetesServicePortEnvVar, "")
+
+	cfg := config.AuthenticationMethodKubernetesConfig{}
+	_, err := cfg.Resolve()
+	require.Error(t, err, "expected an error when issuer cannot be determined out-of-cluster")
+
+	t.Setenv(config.KubernetesServiceHostEnvVar, "kubernetes.default.svc")
+	t.Setenv(config.KubernetesServicePortEnvVar, "443")
+
+	resolved, err := cfg.Resolve()
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "https://kubernetes.default.svc:443", resolved.IssuerURL)
+	assert.Equal(t, config.DefaultKubernetesCAPath, resolved.CAPath)
+	assert.Equal(t, config.DefaultKubernetesServiceAccountTokenPath, resolved.ServiceAccountTokenPath)
+}
+
+func Test_Resolve_ExplicitValues(t *testing.T) {
+	cfg := config.AuthenticationMethodKubernetesConfig{
+		IssuerURL:               "https://api.example.com:6443",
+		CAPath:                  "/custom/ca.crt",
+		ServiceAccountTokenPath: "/custom/token",
+	}
+	resolved, err := cfg.Resolve()
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "https://api.example.com:6443", resolved.IssuerURL)
+	assert.Equal(t, "/custom/ca.crt", resolved.CAPath)
+	assert.Equal(t, "/custom/token", resolved.ServiceAccountTokenPath)
+}
+
+func Test_Info(t *testing.T) {
+	cfg := config.AuthenticationMethodKubernetesConfig{
+		IssuerURL: "https://api.example.com:6443",
+	}
+	info := cfg.Info()
+	assert.Equal(t, auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES, info.Method)
+	assert.False(t, info.SessionCompatible)
+	require.NotNil(t, info.Metadata)
+	// metadata exposes the issuer url
+	field, ok := info.Metadata.AsMap()["issuer_url"]
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	assert.Equal(t, "https://api.example.com:6443", field)
+
+	// no issuer -> no metadata
+	info2 := (config.AuthenticationMethodKubernetesConfig{}).Info()
+	assert.Equal(t, auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES, info2.Method)
+	assert.Nil(t, info2.Metadata)
+}

+func Test_Server_ListAuthenticationMethods_Kubernetes(t *testing.T) {
+	logger := zaptest.NewLogger(t)
+
+	conf := config.AuthenticationConfig{
+		Methods: config.AuthenticationMethods{
+			Token: config.AuthenticationMethod[config.AuthenticationMethodTokenConfig]{
+				Enabled: true,
+			},
+			Kubernetes: config.AuthenticationMethod[config.AuthenticationMethodKubernetesConfig]{
+				Enabled: true,
+				Method: config.AuthenticationMethodKubernetesConfig{
+					IssuerURL: "https://kubernetes.default.svc",
+				},
+			},
+		},
+	}
+
+	server := NewServer(logger, conf)
+
+	resp, err := server.ListAuthenticationMethods(context.Background(), &emptypb.Empty{})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NotNil(t, resp)
+
+	// collect methods by enum
+	byMethod := make(map[auth.Method]*auth.MethodInfo)
+	for _, m := range resp.Methods {
+		byMethod[m.Method] = m
+	}
+
+	// token present and enabled
+	token, ok := byMethod[auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN]
+	require.True(t, ok, "expected the token method to be exposed")
+	assert.True(t, token.Enabled)
+
+	// kubernetes present, enabled, not session compatible, with issuer metadata
+	kube, ok := byMethod[auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES]
+	require.True(t, ok, "expected the kubernetes method to be exposed")
+	assert.True(t, kube.Enabled)
+	assert.False(t, kube.SessionCompatible)
+	require.NotNil(t, kube.Metadata)
+	issuer, ok := kube.Metadata.AsMap()["issuer_url"]
+	require.True(t, ok, "expected issuer_url metadata to be exposed")
+	assert.Equal(t, "https://kubernetes.default.svc", issuer)
+
+	// oidc present but disabled (not configured)
+	oidc, ok := byMethod[auth.Method_METHOD_OIDC]
+	require.True(t, ok, "expected the oidc method to be exposed")
+	assert.False(t, oidc.Enabled)
+}
+
+func Test_Server_ListAuthenticationMethods_BackwardCompatible(t *testing.T) {
+	logger := zaptest.NewLogger(t)
+
+	// a config with only the token method enabled (as before kubernetes existed)
+	conf := config.AuthenticationConfig{
+		Methods: config.AuthenticationMethods{
+			Token: config.AuthenticationMethod[config.AuthenticationMethodTokenConfig]{
+				Enabled: true,
+			},
+		},
+	}
+
+	server := NewServer(logger, conf)
+	resp, err := server.ListAuthenticationMethods(context.Background(), &emptypb.Empty{})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	byMethod := make(map[auth.Method]*auth.MethodInfo)
+	for _, m := range resp.Methods {
+		byMethod[m.Method] = m
+	}
+
+	// kubernetes should be reported but disabled
+	kube, ok := byMethod[auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES]
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	assert.False(t, kube.Enabled, "kubernetes should be disabled when not configured")
+}

+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+
+	goredis "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+// NewClient creates a new redis client from the provided
+// RedisCacheConfig. It applies any TLS, connection pool
+// and network timeout configuration to the underlying client.
+func NewClient(cfg config.RedisCacheConfig) (*goredis.Client, error) {
+	opts := &goredis.Options{
+		Addr:     fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", cfg.Host, cfg.Port),
+		Password: cfg.Password,
+		DB:       cfg.DB,
+	}
+
+	if cfg.PoolSize > 0 {
+		opts.PoolSize = cfg.PoolSize
+	}
+
+	if cfg.MinIdleConns > 0 {
+		opts.MinIdleConns = cfg.MinIdleConns
+	}
+
+	if cfg.MaxIdleConnTime > 0 {
+		opts.ConnMaxIdleTime = cfg.MaxIdleConnTime
+	}
+
+	if cfg.Timeout > 0 {
+		opts.DialTimeout = cfg.Timeout
+		opts.ReadTimeout = cfg.Timeout
+		opts.WriteTimeout = cfg.Timeout
+	}
+
+	if cfg.TLS {
+		tlsConfig, err := NewTLSConfig(cfg)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("creating redis tls config: %w", err)
+		}
+
+		opts.TLSConfig = tlsConfig
+	}
+
+	return goredis.NewClient(opts), nil
+}
+
+// NewTLSConfig creates a new tls.Config from the provided
+// RedisCacheConfig. It is responsible for loading any CA,
+// client certificate and client key referenced by the config.
+//
+// An error is returned if TLS is not enabled or if any of
+// the referenced certificates cannot be loaded or parsed.
+func NewTLSConfig(cfg config.RedisCacheConfig) (*tls.Config, error) {
+	if !cfg.TLS {
+		return nil, errors.New("tls is not enabled")
+	}
+
+	tlsConfig := &tls.Config{
+		MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12,
+	}
+
+	if cfg.CA != "" {
+		caCert, err := os.ReadFile(cfg.CA)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading ca certificate: %w", err)
+		}
+
+		pool := x509.NewCertPool()
+		if !pool.AppendCertsFromPEM(caCert) {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing ca certificate: %q", cfg.CA)
+		}
+
+		tlsConfig.RootCAs = pool
+	}
+
+	if cfg.Cert != "" {
+		if cfg.Key == "" {
+			return nil, errors.New("key must be provided when cert is set")
+		}
+
+		cert, err := tls.LoadX509KeyPair(cfg.Cert, cfg.Key)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("loading client certificate: %w", err)
+		}
+
+		tlsConfig.Certificates = []tls.Certificate{cert}
+	}
+
+	return tlsConfig, nil
+}

+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/rand"
+	"crypto/rsa"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"crypto/x509/pkix"
+	"encoding/pem"
+	"math/big"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+// tlsTestWritePEM writes the supplied DER bytes to path as PEM encoded data.
+func tlsTestWritePEM(t *testing.T, path string, der []byte, blockType string) {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	f, err := os.Create(path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer f.Close()
+
+	require.NoError(t, pem.Encode(f, &pem.Block{Type: blockType, Bytes: der}))
+}
+
+// tlsTestGenerateCA generates a self-signed CA certificate and returns its
+// parsed certificate, private key and DER encoded form.
+func tlsTestGenerateCA(t *testing.T) (*x509.Certificate, *rsa.PrivateKey, []byte) {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	key, err := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	template := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(1),
+		Subject:               pkix.Name{CommonName: "flipt-test-ca"},
+		NotBefore:             time.Now().Add(-time.Hour),
+		NotAfter:              time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
+		IsCA:                  true,
+		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageCertSign | x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature,
+		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
+	}
+
+	der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, template, template, &key.PublicKey, key)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	cert, err := x509.ParseCertificate(der)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	return cert, key, der
+}
+
+// tlsTestGenerateClientCert generates a client certificate signed by the supplied CA
+// and returns its parsed certificate, private key and DER encoded form.
+func tlsTestGenerateClientCert(t *testing.T, ca *x509.Certificate, caKey *rsa.PrivateKey) (*x509.Certificate, *rsa.PrivateKey, []byte) {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	key, err := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	template := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber: big.NewInt(2),
+		Subject:      pkix.Name{CommonName: "localhost"},
+		NotBefore:    time.Now().Add(-time.Hour),
+		NotAfter:     time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
+		KeyUsage:     x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature | x509.KeyUsageKeyEncipherment,
+		ExtKeyUsage:  []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageClientAuth, x509.ExtKeyUsageServerAuth},
+		DNSNames:     []string{"localhost"},
+	}
+
+	der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, template, ca, &key.PublicKey, caKey)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	cert, err := x509.ParseCertificate(der)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	return cert, key, der
+}
+
+// tlsTestCertFiles generates a CA, client certificate and key on disk
+// and returns their paths.
+func tlsTestCertFiles(t *testing.T) (ca, cert, key string) {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	dir := t.TempDir()
+
+	_, caKey, caDer := tlsTestGenerateCA(t)
+
+	caCert, err := x509.ParseCertificate(caDer)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	_, clientKey, clientDer := tlsTestGenerateClientCert(t, caCert, caKey)
+
+	ca = filepath.Join(dir, "ca.crt")
+	tlsTestWritePEM(t, ca, caDer, "CERTIFICATE")
+
+	cert = filepath.Join(dir, "client.crt")
+	tlsTestWritePEM(t, cert, clientDer, "CERTIFICATE")
+
+	keyDer := x509.MarshalPKCS1PrivateKey(clientKey)
+	key = filepath.Join(dir, "client.key")
+	tlsTestWritePEM(t, key, keyDer, "RSA PRIVATE KEY")
+
+	return ca, cert, key
+}
+
+func TestTLSConfigConstruction(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Run("tls disabled", func(t *testing.T) {
+		_, err := NewTLSConfig(config.RedisCacheConfig{})
+		require.Error(t, err)
+		assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "tls is not enabled")
+	})
+
+	t.Run("with ca", func(t *testing.T) {
+		ca, _, _ := tlsTestCertFiles(t)
+
+		tlsConfig, err := NewTLSConfig(config.RedisCacheConfig{
+			TLS: true,
+			CA:  ca,
+		})
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		require.NotNil(t, tlsConfig.RootCAs)
+	})
+
+	t.Run("with client certificate", func(t *testing.T) {
+		ca, cert, key := tlsTestCertFiles(t)
+
+		tlsConfig, err := NewTLSConfig(config.RedisCacheConfig{
+			TLS:  true,
+			CA:   ca,
+			Cert: cert,
+			Key:  key,
+		})
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		require.Len(t, tlsConfig.Certificates, 1)
+		require.NotNil(t, tlsConfig.RootCAs)
+	})
+
+	t.Run("cert without key", func(t *testing.T) {
+		_, cert, _ := tlsTestCertFiles(t)
+
+		_, err := NewTLSConfig(config.RedisCacheConfig{
+			TLS:  true,
+			Cert: cert,
+		})
+		require.Error(t, err)
+		assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "key must be provided when cert is set")
+	})
+
+	t.Run("missing ca file", func(t *testing.T) {
+		_, err := NewTLSConfig(config.RedisCacheConfig{
+			TLS: true,
+			CA:  "/nonexistent/ca.crt",
+		})
+		require.Error(t, err)
+		assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "reading ca certificate")
+	})
+
+	t.Run("invalid ca file", func(t *testing.T) {
+		dir := t.TempDir()
+		badCA := filepath.Join(dir, "bad-ca.crt")

+package redis
+
+import (
+	"bufio"
+	"crypto/ecdsa"
+	"crypto/elliptic"

+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"

+)
+
+// e2eTLSNewServer is a tiny in-process RESP2 server over TLS that
+// supports the subset of commands needed to exercise the cache client:
+// PING, SELECT, SET, GET, DEL, QUIT.
+func e2eTLSNewServer(t *testing.T) (addr string, caFile string, cleanup func()) {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	// CA
+	caKey, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	caTmpl := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(1),
+		Subject:               pkix.Name{CommonName: "e2e-ca"},
+		NotBefore:             time.Now().Add(-time.Hour),
+		NotAfter:              time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
+		IsCA:                  true,
+		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageCertSign,
+		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
+	}
+	caDer, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, caTmpl, caTmpl, &caKey.PublicKey, caKey)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	caCert, err := x509.ParseCertificate(caDer)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+
+	// server cert
+	srvKey, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	srvTmpl := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber: big.NewInt(2),
+		Subject:      pkix.Name{CommonName: "localhost"},
+		NotBefore:    time.Now().Add(-time.Hour),
+		NotAfter:     time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
+		KeyUsage:     x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature | x509.KeyUsageKeyEncipherment,
+		ExtKeyUsage:  []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageServerAuth},
+		DNSNames:     []string{"localhost"},
+		IPAddresses:  []net.IP{net.ParseIP("127.0.0.1")},
+	}
+	srvDer, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, srvTmpl, caCert, &srvKey.PublicKey, caKey)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+
+	dir := t.TempDir()
+	caFile = filepath.Join(dir, "ca.crt")
+	e2eTLSWriteFile(t, caFile, pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: caDer}))
+
+	certFile := filepath.Join(dir, "srv.crt")
+	e2eTLSWriteFile(t, certFile, pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: srvDer}))
+	keyFile := filepath.Join(dir, "srv.key")
+	keyBytes, err := x509.MarshalPKCS8PrivateKey(srvKey)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	e2eTLSWriteFile(t, keyFile, pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "PRIVATE KEY", Bytes: keyBytes}))
+
+	srvCert, err := tls.LoadX509KeyPair(certFile, keyFile)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+
+	ln, err := tls.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0", &tls.Config{
+		Certificates: []tls.Certificate{srvCert},
+		MinVersion:   tls.VersionTLS12,
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+
+	store := map[string]string{}
+
+	go func() {
+		for {
+			conn, err := ln.Accept()
+			if err != nil {
+				return
+			}
+			go e2eTLSHandleConn(conn, store)
+		}
+	}()
+
+	return ln.Addr().String(), caFile, func() { _ = ln.Close() }
+}
+
+func e2eTLSWriteFile(t *testing.T, path string, data []byte) {
+	t.Helper()
+	if err := os.WriteFile(path, data, 0600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+}
+
+func e2eTLSHandleConn(conn net.Conn, store map[string]string) {
+	defer conn.Close()
+	r := bufio.NewReader(conn)
+
+	for {
+		args, err := e2eTLSReadCommand(r)
+		if err != nil {
+			return
+		}
+		if len(args) == 0 {
+			continue
+		}
+
+		cmd := strings.ToUpper(args[0])
+		switch cmd {
+		case "PING":
+			e2eTLSWriteReply(conn, "+PONG\r\n")
+		case "SELECT", "AUTH", "CLIENT":
+			e2eTLSWriteReply(conn, "+OK\r\n")
+		case "SET":
+			if len(args) < 3 {
+				e2eTLSWriteReply(conn, "-ERR wrong number of arguments\r\n")
+				continue
+			}
+			store[args[1]] = args[2]
+			e2eTLSWriteReply(conn, "+OK\r\n")
+		case "GET":
+			if len(args) < 2 {
+				e2eTLSWriteReply(conn, "-ERR wrong number of arguments\r\n")
+				continue
+			}
+			if v, ok := store[args[1]]; ok {
+				e2eTLSWriteReply(conn, fmt.Sprintf("$%d\r\n%s\r\n", len(v), v))
+			} else {
+				e2eTLSWriteReply(conn, "$-1\r\n")
+			}
+		case "DEL":
+			if len(args) >= 2 {
+				delete(store, args[1])
+			}
+			e2eTLSWriteReply(conn, ":1\r\n")
+		case "QUIT":
+			e2eTLSWriteReply(conn, "+OK\r\n")
+			return
+		default:
+			e2eTLSWriteReply(conn, "-ERR unknown command\r\n")
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+// readCommand reads a single RESP array of bulk strings.
+func e2eTLSReadCommand(r *bufio.Reader) ([]string, error) {
+	line, err := r.ReadString('\n')
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	line = strings.TrimRight(line, "\r\n")
+	if line == "" {
+		return nil, nil
+	}
+	if !strings.HasPrefix(line, "*") {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected line %q", line)
+	}
+	n, err := strconv.Atoi(line[1:])
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	args := make([]string, 0, n)
+	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
+		hdr, err := r.ReadString('\n')
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		hdr = strings.TrimRight(hdr, "\r\n")
+		if !strings.HasPrefix(hdr, "$") {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected header %q", hdr)
+		}
+		l, err := strconv.Atoi(hdr[1:])
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		buf := make([]byte, l+2)
+		if _, err := io.ReadFull(r, buf); err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		args = append(args, string(buf[:l]))
+	}
+	return args, nil
+}
+
+func e2eTLSWriteReply(conn net.Conn, s string) {
+	_, _ = io.WriteString(conn, s)
+}
+
+// TestEndToEndTLSCache is a live end-to-end check that a cache built from
+// NewClient can connect to a TLS server, verify the server certificate
+// against the configured CA and perform reads/writes.
+func TestEndToEndTLSCache(t *testing.T) {
+	if testing.Short() {
+		t.Skip("skipping e2e test in short mode")
+	}
+
+	addr, caFile, cleanup := e2eTLSNewServer(t)
+	defer cleanup()
+
+	host, portStr, err := net.SplitHostPort(addr)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	port, err := strconv.Atoi(portStr)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+
+	client, err := NewClient(config.RedisCacheConfig{
+		Host:     host,
+		Port:     port,
+		TLS:      true,
+		CA:       caFile,
+		PoolSize: 5,
+		Timeout:  5 * time.Second,
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer client.Close()
+
+	if err := client.Ping(t.Context()).Err(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("ping over tls: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	if err := client.Set(t.Context(), "e2e-key", "e2e-value", 0).Err(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("set over tls: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	v, err := client.Get(t.Context(), "e2e-key").Result()
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("get over tls: %v", err)
+	}
+	if v != "e2e-value" {
+		t.Fatalf("expected e2e-value, got %q", v)
+	}
+}
+
+// TestEndToEndTLSVerification ensures server certificate verification
+// is enforced: connecting with an untrusted CA must fail.
+func TestEndToEndTLSVerification(t *testing.T) {
+	if testing.Short() {
+		t.Skip("skipping e2e test in short mode")
+	}
+
+	addr, wrongCAFile, cleanup := e2eTLSNewServer(t)
+	defer cleanup()
+
+	// generate a second, unrelated CA to act as the untrusted one
+	caKey, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	caTmpl := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(99),
+		Subject:               pkix.Name{CommonName: "unrelated-ca"},
+		NotBefore:             time.Now().Add(-time.Hour),
+		NotAfter:              time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
+		IsCA:                  true,
+		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageCertSign,
+		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
+	}
+	caDer, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, caTmpl, caTmpl, &caKey.PublicKey, caKey)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	e2eTLSWriteFile(t, wrongCAFile, pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: caDer}))
+
+	host, portStr, err := net.SplitHostPort(addr)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	port, err := strconv.Atoi(portStr)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+
+	client, err := NewClient(config.RedisCacheConfig{
+		Host:    host,
+		Port:    port,
+		TLS:     true,
+		CA:      wrongCAFile,
+		Timeout: 5 * time.Second,
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer client.Close()
+
+	if err := client.Ping(t.Context()).Err(); err == nil {
+		t.Fatal("expected ping to fail with untrusted ca")
+	}
+}

+// validate ensures the redis cache configuration is within
+// reasonable ranges and compatible with redis server capabilities.
+func (c *RedisCacheConfig) validate() error {
+	if c.Host == "" {
+		return errors.New("host must be specified")
+	}
+
+	if c.Port < 1 || c.Port > 65535 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("port must be between 1 and 65535, got %d", c.Port)
+	}
+
+	if c.DB < 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("db must be greater than or equal to 0, got %d", c.DB)
+	}
+
+	if c.Cert != "" && c.Key == "" {
+		return errors.New("key must be provided when cert is set")
+	}
+
+	if c.Key != "" && c.Cert == "" {
+		return errors.New("cert must be provided when key is set")
+	}
+
+	if c.PoolSize < 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("pool_size must be greater than or equal to 0, got %d", c.PoolSize)
+	}
+
+	if c.MinIdleConns < 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("min_idle_conns must be greater than or equal to 0, got %d", c.MinIdleConns)
+	}
+
+	if c.PoolSize > 0 && c.MinIdleConns > c.PoolSize {
+		return fmt.Errorf("min_idle_conns must be less than or equal to pool_size, got min_idle_conns=%d pool_size=%d", c.MinIdleConns, c.PoolSize)
+	}
+
+	if c.MaxIdleConnTime < 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("max_idle_conn_time must be greater than or equal to 0, got %s", c.MaxIdleConnTime)
+	}
+
+	if c.Timeout < 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("timeout must be greater than or equal to 0, got %s", c.Timeout)
+	}
+
+	return nil
 }

+func TestRedisCacheConfigValidation(t *testing.T) {
+	valid := func() *CacheConfig {
+		return &CacheConfig{
+			Backend: CacheRedis,
+			Redis: RedisCacheConfig{
+				Host:            "localhost",
+				Port:            6379,
+				PoolSize:        10,
+				MaxIdleConnTime: 30 * time.Minute,
+				Timeout:         5 * time.Second,
+			},
+		}
+	}
+
+	tests := []struct {
+		name    string
+		mutate  func(c *CacheConfig)
+		wantErr string
+	}{
+		{
+			name:   "valid",
+			mutate: func(c *CacheConfig) {},
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "tls with cert and key",
+			mutate: func(c *CacheConfig) { c.Redis.TLS = true; c.Redis.Cert = "/cert"; c.Redis.Key = "/key" },
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "memory backend ignores redis",
+			mutate: func(c *CacheConfig) { c.Backend = CacheMemory; c.Redis.Port = 0; c.Redis.PoolSize = -1 },
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "empty host",
+			mutate:  func(c *CacheConfig) { c.Redis.Host = "" },
+			wantErr: "host must be specified",
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "port too low",
+			mutate:  func(c *CacheConfig) { c.Redis.Port = 0 },
+			wantErr: "port must be between 1 and 65535",
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "port too high",
+			mutate:  func(c *CacheConfig) { c.Redis.Port = 65536 },
+			wantErr: "port must be between 1 and 65535",
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "negative db",
+			mutate:  func(c *CacheConfig) { c.Redis.DB = -1 },
+			wantErr: "db must be greater than or equal to 0",
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "negative pool size",
+			mutate:  func(c *CacheConfig) { c.Redis.PoolSize = -1 },
+			wantErr: "pool_size must be greater than or equal to 0",
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "negative min idle conns",
+			mutate:  func(c *CacheConfig) { c.Redis.MinIdleConns = -1 },
+			wantErr: "min_idle_conns must be greater than or equal to 0",
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "min idle conns exceeds pool size",
+			mutate:  func(c *CacheConfig) { c.Redis.MinIdleConns = 20 },
+			wantErr: "min_idle_conns must be less than or equal to pool_size",
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "negative max idle conn time",
+			mutate:  func(c *CacheConfig) { c.Redis.MaxIdleConnTime = -time.Second },
+			wantErr: "max_idle_conn_time must be greater than or equal to 0",
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "negative timeout",
+			mutate:  func(c *CacheConfig) { c.Redis.Timeout = -time.Second },
+			wantErr: "timeout must be greater than or equal to 0",
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "cert without key",
+			mutate:  func(c *CacheConfig) { c.Redis.Cert = "/cert" },
+			wantErr: "key must be provided when cert is set",
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "key without cert",
+			mutate:  func(c *CacheConfig) { c.Redis.Key = "/key" },
+			wantErr: "cert must be provided when key is set",
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			c := valid()
+			tt.mutate(c)
+
+			err := c.validate()
+
+			if tt.wantErr == "" {
+				assert.NoError(t, err)
+				return
+			}
+
+			require.Error(t, err)
+			assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), tt.wantErr)
+		})
+	}
+}

+++ b/internal/oci/file.go
@@ -0,0 +1,414 @@
+package oci
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"io"
+	"io/fs"
+	"net/url"
+	"os"
+	"path"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/opencontainers/go-digest"
+	ocispec "github.com/opencontainers/image-spec/specs-go/v1"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/containers"
+	"oras.land/oras-go/v2/registry"
+	"oras.land/oras-go/v2/registry/remote"
+	"oras.land/oras-go/v2/registry/remote/auth"
+)
+
+const (
+	// schemeHTTP is the URL scheme for remote HTTP repositories.
+	schemeHTTP = "http"
+
+	// schemeHTTPS is the URL scheme for remote HTTPS repositories.
+	schemeHTTPS = "https"
+
+	// schemeFlipt is the URL scheme for local Flipt bundle repositories.
+	schemeFlipt = "flipt"
+
+	// bundlesDir is the subdirectory of the Flipt configuration directory
+	// within which local feature bundles are stored.
+	bundlesDir = "bundles"
+
+	// defaultTag is the tag used when a bundle reference does not
+	// specify an explicit tag.
+	defaultTag = "latest"
+
+	// annotationRefName is the standard OCI annotation which
+	// identifies the tag a manifest is associated with.
+	// see: https://github.com/opencontainers/image-spec/blob/main/annotations/annotations.md
+	annotationRefName = "org.opencontainers.image.ref.name"
+)
+
+var (
+	_ fs.File     = (*File)(nil)
+	_ fs.FileInfo = (*FileInfo)(nil)
+)
+
+// Store is a feature bundle store which can retrieve Flipt feature
+// bundles from both remote (http://, https://) and local (flipt://)
+// OCI repositories.
+type Store struct {
+	// ref is the parsed reference of the remote repository.
+	ref registry.Reference
+
+	// repo is the client for the remote OCI repository.
+	repo *remote.Repository
+
+	// local is the filesystem path to a local OCI bundle layout.
+	local string
+}
+
+// NewStore returns a new Store configured from the supplied OCI configuration.
+// The scheme of the repository reference determines the type of store:
+//
+//   - http:// and https:// references point to a remote OCI registry.
+//   - flipt:// references point to a local bundle within the Flipt
+//     configuration directory.
+//
+// Any other scheme is not supported and will return an error.
+func NewStore(cfg *config.OCI) (Store, error) {
+	u, err := url.Parse(cfg.Repository)
+	if err != nil {
+		return Store{}, fmt.Errorf("parsing repository %q: %w", cfg.Repository, err)
+	}
+
+	var store Store
+	switch u.Scheme {
+	case schemeHTTP, schemeHTTPS:
+		// strip the scheme from the repository in order to derive
+		// a registry reference of the form <host>[:<port>]/<path>[:<tag>].
+		ref, err := registry.ParseReference(strings.TrimPrefix(u.Host+u.Path, "/"))
+		if err != nil {
+			return Store{}, fmt.Errorf("parsing repository reference %q: %w", cfg.Repository, err)
+		}
+
+		repo, err := remote.NewRepository(ref.String())
+		if err != nil {
+			return Store{}, fmt.Errorf("creating remote repository %q: %w", cfg.Repository, err)
+		}
+
+		// access the remote repository over plain HTTP when the scheme
+		// is http or insecure access is configured.
+		repo.PlainHTTP = u.Scheme == schemeHTTP || cfg.Insecure
+
+		// configure credentials when authentication is provided
+		if cfg.Authentication != nil {
+			repo.Client = &auth.Client{
+				Credential: func(ctx context.Context, hostport string) (auth.Credential, error) {
+					return auth.Credential{
+						Username: cfg.Authentication.Username,
+						Password: cfg.Authentication.Password,
+					}, nil
+				},
+			}
+		}
+
+		store.ref = ref
+		store.repo = repo
+	case schemeFlipt:
+		dir, err := config.Dir()
+		if err != nil {
+			return Store{}, fmt.Errorf("resolving local bundle directory: %w", err)
+		}
+
+		store.local = filepath.Join(dir, bundlesDir, path.Clean(u.Path))
+	default:
+		return Store{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported repository scheme %q for repository %q", u.Scheme, cfg.Repository)
+	}
+
+	return store, nil
+}
+
+// FetchOptions contains options for a Store.Fetch operation.
+type FetchOptions struct {
+	// IfNoneMatch is the digest of a previously fetched manifest.
+	// When the digest of the fetched manifest matches, the Fetch
+	// operation returns early with the Matched flag set to true and
+	// no bundle files are retrieved.
+	IfNoneMatch digest.Digest
+}
+
+// IfNoMatch returns an option for Store.Fetch which enables
+// digest-aware caching. When the digest of the fetched manifest
+// matches the supplied digest, Fetch will return early with the
+// Matched flag set to true.
+func IfNoMatch(d digest.Digest) containers.Option[FetchOptions] {
+	return func(o *FetchOptions) {
+		o.IfNoneMatch = d
+	}
+}
+
+// FetchResponse is the result of a Store.Fetch operation.
+type FetchResponse struct {
+	// ManifestDigest is the normalized digest of the fetched manifest.
+	ManifestDigest digest.Digest
+
+	// Files is the set of files retrieved from the layers of the
+	// fetched manifest. It is empty when Matched is true.
+	Files []fs.File
+
+	// Matched indicates the fetched manifest matched the IfNoneMatch
+	// digest supplied via options, in which case no files were retrieved.
+	Matched bool
+}
+
+// Fetch retrieves the feature bundle from the store's repository.
+// It returns the normalized manifest digest along with the bundle files
+// derived from the layers of the manifest.
+func (s Store) Fetch(ctx context.Context, opts ...containers.Option[FetchOptions]) (*FetchResponse, error) {
+	var options FetchOptions
+	containers.ApplyAll(&options, opts...)
+
+	manifestBytes, err := s.fetchManifest(ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	var manifest ocispec.Manifest
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(manifestBytes, &manifest); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing manifest: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	manifestDigest, err := manifestDigest(&manifest)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	// given the manifest has not changed since the supplied digest
+	// we can return early without fetching any of the bundle layers.
+	if options.IfNoneMatch != "" && options.IfNoneMatch == manifestDigest {
+		return &FetchResponse{
+			ManifestDigest: manifestDigest,
+			Matched:        true,
+		}, nil
+	}
+
+	var files []fs.File
+	for _, layer := range manifest.Layers {
+		file, err := s.fetchLayer(ctx, layer)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+
+		files = append(files, file)
+	}
+
+	return &FetchResponse{
+		ManifestDigest: manifestDigest,
+		Files:          files,
+	}, nil
+}
+
+// fetchManifest fetches the raw manifest bytes from the store's repository.
+func (s Store) fetchManifest(ctx context.Context) ([]byte, error) {
+	var (
+		rc  io.ReadCloser
+		err error
+	)
+
+	if s.local != "" {
+		rc, err = s.fetchLocalManifest(ctx)
+	} else {
+		_, rc, err = s.repo.FetchReference(ctx, s.ref.ReferenceOrDefault())
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	defer rc.Close()
+
+	return io.ReadAll(rc)
+}
+
+// fetchLocalManifest fetches the manifest from a local OCI bundle layout.
+func (s Store) fetchLocalManifest(ctx context.Context) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
+	indexBytes, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(s.local, "index.json"))
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading local bundle index: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	var index ocispec.Index
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(indexBytes, &index); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing local bundle index: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	if len(index.Manifests) == 0 {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("local bundle %q does not contain any manifests", s.local)
+	}
+
+	// resolve the manifest tagged as "latest" when present,
+	// otherwise fall back to the first manifest in the index.
+	desc := index.Manifests[0]
+	for _, m := range index.Manifests {
+		if m.Annotations[annotationRefName] == defaultTag {
+			desc = m
+			break
+		}
+	}
+
+	p, err := blobPath(s.local, desc.Digest)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	f, err := os.Open(p)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("opening local bundle manifest: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	return f, nil
+}
+
+// fetchLayer validates the media type of a manifest layer and
+// fetches its contents, wrapping it in a File.
+func (s Store) fetchLayer(ctx context.Context, layer ocispec.Descriptor) (fs.File, error) {
+	switch layer.MediaType {
+	case MediaTypeFliptFeatures, MediaTypeFliptNamespace:
+		// supported media type
+	default:
+		if layer.MediaType == "" {
+			return nil, ErrMissingMediaType
+		}
+
+		return nil, ErrUnexpectedMediaType
+	}
+
+	var (
+		rc  io.ReadCloser
+		err error
+	)
+
+	if s.local != "" {
+		p, err := blobPath(s.local, layer.Digest)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+
+		rc, err = os.Open(p)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("opening local bundle layer: %w", err)
+		}
+	} else {
+		rc, err = s.repo.Fetch(ctx, layer)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+	}
+
+	return &File{
+		ReadCloser: rc,
+		info: FileInfo{
+			name:    layer.Digest.Hex() + "." + encodingOf(layer.MediaType),
+			size:    layer.Size,
+			modTime: time.Time{},
+			mode:    0o644,
+		},
+	}, nil
+}
+
+// File is an implementation of fs.File which wraps an underlying
+// io.ReadCloser containing the contents of a bundle layer.
+type File struct {
+	io.ReadCloser
+
+	info FileInfo
+}
+
+// Seek repositions the underlying reader, when supported.
+func (f *File) Seek(offset int64, whence int) (int64, error) {
+	if seeker, ok := f.ReadCloser.(io.Seeker); ok {
+		return seeker.Seek(offset, whence)
+	}
+
+	return 0, errors.New("seek not supported")
+}
+
+// Stat returns the FileInfo describing the file.
+func (f *File) Stat() (fs.FileInfo, error) {
+	return f.info, nil
+}
+
+// FileInfo is an implementation of fs.FileInfo for files
+// retrieved from a feature bundle.
+type FileInfo struct {
+	name    string
+	size    int64
+	modTime time.Time
+	mode    fs.FileMode
+}
+
+// Name returns the name of the file. It is derived from the hex
+// value of the file's content digest concatenated with the encoding
+// extension (e.g. <digest>.json or <digest>.yaml).
+func (f FileInfo) Name() string {
+	return f.name
+}
+
+// Size returns the size in bytes of the file.
+func (f FileInfo) Size() int64 {
+	return f.size
+}
+
+// Mode returns the permission bits for the file.
+func (f FileInfo) Mode() fs.FileMode {
+	return f.mode
+}
+
+// ModTime returns the modification time of the file.
+func (f FileInfo) ModTime() time.Time {
+	return f.modTime
+}
+
+// IsDir always returns false as bundle files are never directories.
+func (f FileInfo) IsDir() bool {
+	return false
+}
+
+// Sys returns nil as there is no underlying system data source.
+func (f FileInfo) Sys() any {
+	return nil
+}
+
+// manifestDigest returns the digest of the supplied manifest.
+// The manifest is normalized by removing its annotations before
+// the digest is computed in order to ensure a consistent and
+// repeatable value regardless of how the manifest was produced.
+func manifestDigest(m *ocispec.Manifest) (digest.Digest, error) {
+	annotations := m.Annotations
+	m.Annotations = nil
+	defer func() { m.Annotations = annotations }()
+
+	b, err := json.Marshal(m)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("marshaling manifest: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	return digest.FromBytes(b), nil
+}
+
+// encodingOf extracts the encoding from an OCI media type.
+// e.g. application/vnd.flipt.features.v1+yaml -> yaml
+func encodingOf(mediaType string) string {
+	if i := strings.LastIndex(mediaType, "+"); i != -1 {
+		return mediaType[i+1:]
+	}
+
+	return ""
+}
+
+// blobPath returns the path to a blob within an OCI layout,
+// given the layout root and the blob's digest.
+func blobPath(root string, d digest.Digest) (string, error) {
+	if err := d.Validate(); err != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid blob digest %q: %w", d, err)
+	}
+
+	return filepath.Join(root, "blobs", d.Algorithm().String(), d.Hex()[:2], d.Hex()[2:]), nil
+}

+package oci

+	MediaTypeFliptFeatures = "application/vnd.flipt.features.v1+yaml"
+
+	// MediaTypeFliptNamespace is the media type for OCI layers which
+	// contain Flipt namespace state.
+	MediaTypeFliptNamespace = "application/vnd.flipt.namespace.v1+yaml"
+
+	// AnnotationFliptNamespace is the annotation key which identifies
+	// the Flipt namespace a bundle is associated with.
+	AnnotationFliptNamespace = "dev.flipt.namespace"
+)
+
+var (
+	// ErrMissingMediaType is returned when a manifest layer descriptor
+	// is encountered without a media type.
+	ErrMissingMediaType = errors.New("missing media type")
+
+	// ErrUnexpectedMediaType is returned when a manifest layer descriptor
+	// is encountered with a media type which is not supported by Flipt.
+	ErrUnexpectedMediaType = errors.New("unexpected media type")

+package oci
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"errors"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+

+	v1 "github.com/opencontainers/image-spec/specs-go/v1"
+
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+func writeBlob(t *testing.T, layout, dgst digest.Digest, data []byte) {
+	t.Helper()
+	p := filepath.Join(layout, "blobs", string(dgst.Algorithm()), dgst.Encoded()[:2], dgst.Encoded()[2:])
+	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0o755); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := os.WriteFile(p, data, 0o644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+}
+
+// makeLayout builds an OCI image layout under dir/flipt/bundles/name with the
+// given layer descriptors. Returns the manifest digest.
+func makeLayout(t *testing.T, dir, name string, layers []v1.Descriptor, layerData map[digest.Digest][]byte) digest.Digest {
+	t.Helper()
+	layout := filepath.Join(dir, "flipt", "bundles", name)
+
+	configData := []byte("{}")
+	configDgst := digest.FromBytes(configData)
+	writeBlob(t, layout, configDgst, configData)
+	for dgst, data := range layerData {
+		writeBlob(t, layout, dgst, data)
+	}
+
+	manifest := v1.Manifest{
+		Versioned:   v1.Versioned{SchemaVersion: 2},
+		MediaType:   v1.MediaTypeImageManifest,
+		Config:      v1.Descriptor{MediaType: v1.MediaTypeImageConfigEmptyJSON, Digest: configDgst, Size: int64(len(configData))},
+		Layers:      layers,
+	}
+	mdata, err := json.Marshal(manifest)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	mdgst := digest.FromBytes(mdata)
+	writeBlob(t, layout, mdgst, mdata)
+
+	mdesc := v1.Descriptor{
+		MediaType:   v1.MediaTypeImageManifest,
+		Digest:      mdgst,
+		Size:        int64(len(mdata)),
+		Annotations: map[string]string{"org.opencontainers.image.ref.name": "latest"},
+	}
+	index := v1.Index{
+		Versioned: v1.Versioned{SchemaVersion: 2},
+		MediaType: v1.MediaTypeImageIndex,
+		Manifests: []v1.Descriptor{mdesc},
+	}
+	idata, err := json.Marshal(index)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := os.MkdirAll(layout, 0o755); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(layout, "index.json"), idata, 0o644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(layout, "oci-layout"), []byte(`{"imageLayoutVersion":"1.0.0"}`), 0o644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	return mdgst
+}
+
+func standardLayers(t *testing.T) ([]v1.Descriptor, map[digest.Digest][]byte) {
+	t.Helper()
+	features := []byte(`[{"id":"f1","name":"feature-1","key":"feature-1","enabled":true}]`)
+	namespace := []byte(`[{"id":"n1","name":"default","key":"default"}]`)
+	featDgst := digest.FromBytes(features)
+	nsDgst := digest.FromBytes(namespace)
+	layers := []v1.Descriptor{
+		{MediaType: MediaTypeFliptFeatures, Digest: featDgst, Size: int64(len(features)), Annotations: map[string]string{AnnotationFliptNamespace: "default"}},
+		{MediaType: MediaTypeFliptNamespace, Digest: nsDgst, Size: int64(len(namespace)), Annotations: map[string]string{AnnotationFliptNamespace: "default"}},
+	}
+	return layers, map[digest.Digest][]byte{featDgst: features, nsDgst: namespace}
+}
+
+func TestSmokeNewStoreErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	if _, err := NewStore(&config.OCI{Repository: "ftp://host/repo"}); err == nil {
+		t.Fatal("expected error for unsupported scheme")
+	}
+	if _, err := NewStore(&config.OCI{Repository: "just.a.registry"}); err == nil {
+		t.Fatal("expected error for invalid reference")
+	}
+	if _, err := NewStore(nil); err == nil {
+		t.Fatal("expected error for nil config")
+	}
+	if _, err := NewStore(&config.OCI{}); err == nil {
+		t.Fatal("expected error for empty repository")
+	}
+}
+
+func TestSmokeFetchLocal(t *testing.T) {
+	dir := t.TempDir()
+	t.Setenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", dir)
+	t.Setenv("HOME", dir)
+
+	layers, data := standardLayers(t)
+	want := makeLayout(t, dir, "my-bundle", layers, data)
+
+	store, err := NewStore(&config.OCI{Repository: "flipt://my-bundle"})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	resp, err := store.Fetch(context.Background())
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if resp.ManifestDigest != want {
+		t.Fatalf("manifest digest = %q, want %q", resp.ManifestDigest, want)
+	}
+	if resp.Matched {
+		t.Fatal("expected Matched=false on fresh fetch")
+	}
+	if len(resp.Files) != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("expected 2 files, got %d", len(resp.Files))
+	}
+	for _, f := range resp.Files {
+		info, err := f.Stat()
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		name := info.Name()
+		data := data[digest.Digest{...}] // placeholder replaced below
+		_ = data
+		buf := new(bytes.Buffer)
+		if _, err := buf.ReadFrom(f); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if _, ok := data[digest.Digest{}]; ok {
+		}
+		// find the layer digest matching this file name
+		for l, d := range data {
+			if name == l.Hex()+".json" {
+				if !bytes.Equal(buf.Bytes(), d) {
+					t.Fatalf("file %s content mismatch", name)
+				}
+				if info.Size() != int64(len(d)) {
+					t.Fatalf("file %s size = %d, want %d", name, info.Size(), len(d))
+				}
+				if info.IsDir() {
+					t.Fatal("expected IsDir=false")
+				}
+				if info.Sys() != nil {
+					t.Fatal("expected Sys() nil")
+				}
+				if info.Mode()&0o444 == 0 {
+					t.Fatal("expected readable mode")
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	// cache hit
+	resp2, err := store.Fetch(context.Background(), IfNoMatch(want))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if !resp2.Matched {
+		t.Fatal("expected Matched=true on digest match")
+	}
+	if len(resp2.Files) != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("expected no files on cache hit, got %d", len(resp2.Files))
+	}
+
+	// seek works
+	f := resp.Files[0]
+	n, err := f.Seek(2, 0)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if n != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("seek = %d", n)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestSmokeMediaTypeErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	dir := t.TempDir()
+	t.Setenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", dir)
+	t.Setenv("HOME", dir)
+
+	// missing media type
+	features := []byte(`[{"key":"f1"}]`)
+	dgst := digest.FromBytes(features)
+	layers := []v1.Descriptor{{Digest: dgst, Size: int64(len(features))}}
+	makeLayout(t, dir, "bad1", layers, map[digest.Digest][]byte{dgst: features})
+	store, err := NewStore(&config.OCI{Repository: "flipt://bad1"})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if _, err := store.Fetch(context.Background()); !errors.Is(err, ErrMissingMediaType) {
+		t.Fatalf("expected ErrMissingMediaType, got %v", err)
+	}
+
+	// unexpected media type
+	layers2 := []v1.Descriptor{{MediaType: "application/vnd.example.unknown", Digest: dgst, Size: int64(len(features))}}
+	makeLayout(t, dir, "bad2", layers2, map[digest.Digest][]byte{dgst: features})
+	store2, err := NewStore(&config.OCI{Repository: "flipt://bad2"})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if _, err := store2.Fetch(context.Background()); !errors.Is(err, ErrUnexpectedMediaType) {
+		t.Fatalf("expected ErrUnexpectedMediaType, got %v", err)
+	}
+}

+// envVarSubstitutionPattern matches configuration values of the form

+// (i.e. it starts with a letter or underscore followed by any
+// combination of letters, digits or underscores).
+var envVarSubstitutionPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^\$\{([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\}$`)
+
+// envVarSubstitutionHookFunc returns a DecodeHookFunc that substitutes
+// configuration values of the form ${ENV_VAR} with the value of the
+// referenced environment variable, if it exists.
+//
+// The substitution is applied to values which exactly match the
+// ${ENV_VAR} pattern. Values which do not exactly match the pattern,
+// are not strings, or reference a non-existent environment variable
+// are left unchanged.
+func envVarSubstitutionHookFunc() mapstructure.DecodeHookFunc {
+	return func(
+		f, t reflect.Type,
+		data interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+		raw, ok := data.(string)
+		if !ok {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		matches := envVarSubstitutionPattern.FindStringSubmatch(raw)
+		if matches == nil {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		if value, ok := os.LookupEnv(matches[1]); ok {
+			return value, nil
+		}
+
+		return data, nil
+	}
+}

--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/config/env_substitution_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,78 @@
+package config
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestLoadEnvVarSubstitution(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("MY_HTTP_PORT", "8081")
+	t.Setenv("MY_GRPC_PORT", "9090")
+	t.Setenv("MY_LOG_LEVEL", "DEBUG")
+	t.Setenv("MY_LOG_ENCODING", "json")
+	t.Setenv("MY_CACHE_TTL", "5m")
+
+	res, err := Load(context.Background(), "./testdata/env_substitution.yml")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NotNil(t, res)
+
+	cfg := res.Config
+	// int port values are substituted and correctly decoded as integers
+	assert.Equal(t, 8081, cfg.Server.HTTPPort)
+	assert.Equal(t, 9090, cfg.Server.GRPCPort)
+	// string values are substituted
+	assert.Equal(t, "DEBUG", cfg.Log.Level)
+	// enum (named string) values are substituted and decoded into the target type
+	assert.Equal(t, LogEncodingJSON, cfg.Log.Encoding)
+	// duration values are substituted and decoded into the target type
+	assert.Equal(t, 5*time.Minute, cfg.Cache.TTL)
+}
+
+// TestLoadEnvVarSubstitutionViaFLIPTEnv verifies that values arriving via
+// FLIPT_ prefixed environment variables which themselves contain a
+// ${ENV_VAR} reference are also substituted.
+func TestLoadEnvVarSubstitutionViaFLIPTEnv(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("MY_GRPC_PORT", "9091")
+
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_SERVER_GRPC_PORT", "${MY_GRPC_PORT}")
+
+	res, err := Load(context.Background(), "./testdata/default.yml")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NotNil(t, res)
+
+	assert.Equal(t, 9091, res.Config.Server.GRPCPort)
+}
+
+// TestLoadEnvVarSubstitutionUnset verifies that a value referencing a
+// non-existent environment variable is left unchanged.
+func TestLoadEnvVarSubstitutionUnset(t *testing.T) {
+	res, err := Load(context.Background(), "./testdata/env_substitution_unset.yml")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NotNil(t, res)
+
+	assert.Equal(t, "${MY_UNSET_VAR}", res.Config.Log.File)
+}
+
+// TestLoadEnvVarSubstitutionPattern verifies that values which do not
+// exactly match the ${ENV_VAR} pattern are left unchanged.
+func TestLoadEnvVarSubstitutionPattern(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("MY_VAR", "substituted")
+
+	res, err := Load(context.Background(), "./testdata/env_substitution_pattern.yml")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NotNil(t, res)
+
+	cfg := res.Config
+	// embedded references do not exactly match the pattern
+	assert.Equal(t, "prefix-${MY_VAR}", cfg.Log.File)
+	assert.Equal(t, "${MY_VAR}suffix", cfg.Log.Level)
+	// invalid environment variable names do not match the pattern
+	assert.Equal(t, "${1MY_VAR}", cfg.Log.GRPCLevel)
+	assert.Equal(t, "${MY-VAR}", cfg.Meta.StateDirectory)
+	// a plain value without braces is left unchanged
+	assert.Equal(t, "$MY_VAR", cfg.Database.URL)
+}

+// Package otlp provides a minimal OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP) trace
+// exporter over gRPC for use with the OpenTelemetry Go SDK.
+//
+// The exporter encodes spans directly into the OTLP/gRPC wire format
+// without relying on generated protobuf stubs, keeping the dependency
+// footprint small. It is compatible with any OTLP/gRPC receiving
+// endpoint, such as the OpenTelemetry Collector.
+package otlp
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/binary"
+	"fmt"
+	"math"
+	"sync"
+
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/attribute"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/codes"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/instrumentation"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/resource"
+	tracesdk "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace"
+	"google.golang.org/grpc"
+	"google.golang.org/grpc/credentials/insecure"
+)
+
+// exportMethod is the fully-qualified gRPC method of the OTLP trace
+// collector service (opentelemetry.proto.collector.trace.v1.TraceService/Export).
+const exportMethod = "/opentelemetry.proto.collector.trace.v1.TraceService/Export"
+
+// Exporter is a tracesdk.SpanExporter implementation which sends spans to
+// an OTLP-compatible backend over gRPC.
+type Exporter struct {
+	mu   sync.Mutex
+	conn *grpc.ClientConn
+
+	closed bool
+}
+
+// New creates an Exporter that sends spans to the given OTLP/gRPC endpoint
+// (e.g. "localhost:4317").
+func New(endpoint string) (*Exporter, error) {
+	conn, err := grpc.Dial(
+		endpoint,
+		grpc.WithTransportCredentials(insecure.NewCredentials()),
+	)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("otlp: connecting to %q: %w", endpoint, err)
+	}
+
+	return &Exporter{conn: conn}, nil
+}
+
+// Compile-time check that Exporter implements tracesdk.SpanExporter.
+var _ tracesdk.SpanExporter = (*Exporter)(nil)
+
+// ExportSpans exports a batch of spans to the configured OTLP/gRPC endpoint.
+func (e *Exporter) ExportSpans(ctx context.Context, spans []tracesdk.ReadOnlySpan) error {
+	e.mu.Lock()
+	defer e.mu.Unlock()
+
+	if e.closed {
+		return fmt.Errorf("otlp: exporter is shut down")
+	}
+
+	var (
+		req  = encodeExportRequest(spans)
+		resp []byte
+	)
+
+	if err := e.conn.Invoke(ctx, exportMethod, req, &resp, grpc.ForceCodec(rawCodec{})); err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("otlp: exporting spans: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	return nil
+}
+
+// Shutdown shuts down the exporter, releasing the underlying gRPC
+// connection. Subsequent calls to ExportSpans will return an error.
+func (e *Exporter) Shutdown(_ context.Context) error {
+	e.mu.Lock()
+	defer e.mu.Unlock()
+
+	if e.closed {
+		return nil
+	}
+	e.closed = true
+
+	return e.conn.Close()
+}
+
+// rawCodec passes raw protobuf-encoded bytes through the gRPC transport
+// without re-marshalling them.
+type rawCodec struct{}
+
+func (rawCodec) Marshal(v interface{}) ([]byte, error) {
+	return v.([]byte), nil
+}
+
+func (rawCodec) Unmarshal(data []byte, v interface{}) error {
+	out, ok := v.(*[]byte)
+	if !ok {
+		return fmt.Errorf("otlp: rawCodec: unsupported unmarshal target %T", v)
+	}
+	*out = data
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (rawCodec) Name() string { return "proto" }
+
+// protoWriter is a minimal proto3 encoder supporting the wire types used
+// by the OTLP trace messages.
+type protoWriter struct {
+	buf []byte
+}
+
+func (w *protoWriter) varint(v uint64) {
+	for v >= 0x80 {
+		w.buf = append(w.buf, byte(v)|0x80)
+		v >>= 7
+	}
+	w.buf = append(w.buf, byte(v))
+}
+
+func (w *protoWriter) tag(field int, wireType int) {
+	w.varint(uint64(field)<<3 | uint64(wireType))
+}
+
+func (w *protoWriter) uint64(field int, v uint64) {
+	if v == 0 {
+		return
+	}
+	w.tag(field, 0)
+	w.varint(v)
+}
+
+func (w *protoWriter) int64(field int, v int64) {
+	if v == 0 {
+		return
+	}
+	w.tag(field, 0)
+	w.varint(uint64(v))
+}
+
+func (w *protoWriter) bool(field int, v bool) {
+	if !v {
+		return
+	}
+	w.tag(field, 0)
+	w.varint(1)
+}
+
+func (w *protoWriter) fixed64(field int, v uint64) {
+	if v == 0 {
+		return
+	}
+	w.tag(field, 1)
+	var b [8]byte
+	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(b[:], v)
+	w.buf = append(w.buf, b[:]...)
+}
+
+func (w *protoWriter) double(field int, v float64) {
+	if v == 0 {
+		return
+	}
+	w.fixed64(field, math.Float64bits(v))
+}
+
+func (w *protoWriter) bytes(field int, v []byte) {
+	if len(v) == 0 {
+		return
+	}
+	w.tag(field, 2)
+	w.varint(uint64(len(v)))
+	w.buf = append(w.buf, v...)
+}
+
+func (w *protoWriter) string(field int, v string) {
+	w.bytes(field, []byte(v))
+}
+
+// encodeExportRequest encodes a
+// collector.trace.v1.ExportTraceServiceRequest for the given spans.
+func encodeExportRequest(spans []tracesdk.ReadOnlySpan) []byte {
+	// group spans by (resource, instrumentation scope)
+	groups := make(map[*resource.Resource]map[instrumentation.Scope][]tracesdk.ReadOnlySpan)
+	for _, s := range spans {
+		scope := s.InstrumentationScope()
+		m, ok := groups[s.Resource()]
+		if !ok {
+			m = make(map[instrumentation.Scope][]tracesdk.ReadOnlySpan)
+			groups[s.Resource()] = m
+		}
+		m[scope] = append(m[scope], s)
+	}
+
+	req := &protoWriter{}
+	for res, scopes := range groups {
+		rs := &protoWriter{}
+		rs.bytes(1, encodeResource(res))
+
+		for scope, ss := range scopes {
+			sps := &protoWriter{}
+			sps.bytes(1, encodeScope(scope))
+			for _, s := range ss {
+				sps.bytes(2, encodeSpan(s))
+			}
+			rs.bytes(2, sps.buf)
+		}
+
+		req.bytes(1, rs.buf)
+	}
+
+	return req.buf
+}
+
+// encodeResource encodes resource.v1.Resource and returns its wire bytes.
+func encodeResource(r *resource.Resource) []byte {
+	w := &protoWriter{}
+	for _, kv := range r.Attributes() {
+		w.bytes(1, encodeKeyValue(kv))
+	}
+	return w.buf
+}
+
+// encodeScope encodes common.v1.InstrumentationScope and returns its
+// wire bytes.
+func encodeScope(scope instrumentation.Scope) []byte {
+	w := &protoWriter{}
+	w.string(1, scope.Name)
+	w.string(2, scope.Version)
+	return w.buf
+}
+
+// encodeSpan encodes trace.v1.Span and returns its wire bytes.
+func encodeSpan(s tracesdk.ReadOnlySpan) []byte {
+	w := &protoWriter{}
+
+	var (
+		sc     = s.SpanContext()
+		parent = s.Parent()
+	)
+
+	traceID := sc.TraceID()
+	spanID := sc.SpanID()
+	w.bytes(1, traceID[:])
+	w.bytes(2, spanID[:])
+	w.string(3, sc.TraceState().String())
+	if parent.IsValid() {
+		parentID := parent.SpanID()
+		w.bytes(4, parentID[:])
+	}
+	w.string(5, s.Name())
+	w.uint64(6, uint64(s.SpanKind()))
+	w.fixed64(7, uint64(s.StartTime().UnixNano()))
+	w.fixed64(8, uint64(s.EndTime().UnixNano()))
+
+	for _, kv := range s.Attributes() {
+		w.bytes(9, encodeKeyValue(kv))
+	}
+	w.uint64(10, uint64(s.DroppedAttributes()))
+
+	for _, e := range s.Events() {
+		w.bytes(11, encodeEvent(e))
+	}
+	w.uint64(12, uint64(s.DroppedEvents()))
+
+	for _, l := range s.Links() {
+		w.bytes(13, encodeLink(l))
+	}
+	w.uint64(14, uint64(s.DroppedLinks()))
+
+	w.bytes(15, encodeStatus(s.Status()))
+
+	return w.buf
+}
+
+// encodeEvent encodes trace.v1.Span.Event and returns its wire bytes.
+func encodeEvent(e tracesdk.Event) []byte {
+	w := &protoWriter{}
+	w.fixed64(1, uint64(e.Time.UnixNano()))
+	w.string(2, e.Name)
+	for _, kv := range e.Attributes {
+		w.bytes(3, encodeKeyValue(kv))
+	}
+	w.uint64(4, uint64(e.DroppedAttributeCount))
+	return w.buf
+}
+
+// encodeLink encodes trace.v1.Span.Link and returns its wire bytes.
+func encodeLink(l tracesdk.Link) []byte {
+	w := &protoWriter{}
+
+	sc := l.SpanContext
+	traceID := sc.TraceID()
+	spanID := sc.SpanID()
+	w.bytes(1, traceID[:])
+	w.bytes(2, spanID[:])
+	w.string(3, sc.TraceState().String())
+	for _, kv := range l.Attributes {
+		w.bytes(4, encodeKeyValue(kv))
+	}
+	w.uint64(5, uint64(l.DroppedAttributeCount))
+
+	return w.buf
+}
+
+// encodeStatus encodes trace.v1.Status and returns its wire bytes.
+func encodeStatus(st tracesdk.Status) []byte {
+	w := &protoWriter{}
+	w.string(2, st.Description)
+	switch st.Code {
+	case codes.Ok:
+		w.uint64(3, 1) // STATUS_CODE_OK
+	case codes.Error:
+		w.uint64(3, 2) // STATUS_CODE_ERROR
+	}
+	return w.buf
+}
+
+// encodeKeyValue encodes common.v1.KeyValue and returns its wire bytes.
+func encodeKeyValue(kv attribute.KeyValue) []byte {
+	w := &protoWriter{}
+	w.string(1, string(kv.Key))
+	w.bytes(2, encodeAnyValue(kv.Value))
+	return w.buf
+}
+
+// encodeAnyValue encodes common.v1.AnyValue and returns its wire bytes.
+func encodeAnyValue(v attribute.Value) []byte {
+	w := &protoWriter{}
+
+	switch v.Type() {
+	case attribute.STRING:
+		w.string(1, v.AsString())
+	case attribute.BOOL:
+		w.bool(2, v.AsBool())
+	case attribute.INT64:
+		w.int64(3, v.AsInt64())
+	case attribute.FLOAT64:
+		w.double(4, v.AsFloat64())
+	case attribute.STRINGSLICE:
+		arr := &protoWriter{}
+		for _, s := range v.AsStringSlice() {
+			arr.bytes(1, encodeAnyValue(attribute.StringValue(s)))
+		}
+		w.bytes(5, arr.buf)
+	case attribute.BOOLSLICE:
+		arr := &protoWriter{}
+		for _, b := range v.AsBoolSlice() {
+			arr.bytes(1, encodeAnyValue(attribute.BoolValue(b)))
+		}
+		w.bytes(5, arr.buf)
+	case attribute.INT64SLICE:
+		arr := &protoWriter{}
+		for _, i := range v.AsInt64Slice() {
+			arr.bytes(1, encodeAnyValue(attribute.Int64Value(i)))
+		}
+		w.bytes(5, arr.buf)
+	case attribute.FLOAT64SLICE:
+		arr := &protoWriter{}
+		for _, f := range v.AsFloat64Slice() {
+			arr.bytes(1, encodeAnyValue(attribute.Float64Value(f)))
+		}
+		w.bytes(5, arr.buf)
+	}
+
+	return w.buf
+}

+package otlp
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"net"
+	"sync"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
